result.brief: 研究 DINOv2、SwinV2 等视觉 Transformer 的层冗余，提出免重训练深度剪枝与自动配置选择流程，提升推理效率。
result.reason: Analyzes layer redundancy in DINOv2/SwinV2 vision transformers via input-output similarity and retraining-free depth pruning; touches visual representation encoders but contributes compression, not representation learning.
